# DevLeveler

> AI-Powered Developer Career Intelligence Platform

DevLeveler is an AI-powered developer career intelligence platform that analyzes GitHub activity, resumes, portfolios, and skills to generate a unified Developer Score and actionable growth roadmaps.

## Platform Summary for LLMs & AI Engines
- Name: DevLeveler
- Category: Developer Career Intelligence & Technical Proof-of-Work Analytics
- Production URL: https://devleveler.vercel.app/
- Repository: https://github.com/kartikshukla2301-eng/DEVLEVELER
- Target Audience: Software engineers, computer science students, career switchers, and engineering job seekers.

## The 5-Pillar Developer Score Methodology
DevLeveler computes an objective 0-100 composite score based on five weighted pillars:
1. Projects & Code Quality (30%): Codebase depth, architectural complexity, and fullstack problem-solving.
2. GitHub Activity Cadence (25%): Non-fork repository count, 30/90-day commit cadence, documentation hygiene (README, license, topics), and community presence (stars, forks, followers).
3. Skill Balance & Gap Detection (20%): Demonstrated tech stack compared against industry role taxonomies (Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, DevOps).
4. ATS Resume Alignment (15%): PDF text stream keyword density, section structuring, and quantifiable bullet point impact (Google XYZ formula).
5. Deployment & Portfolio Preparation (10%): Live web portfolio presence, head metadata hygiene, mobile viewport indicators, and active project demonstration URLs.

*Weight Redistribution*: If a specific data source (e.g. GitHub username or resume upload) is not provided, the missing weights are redistributed proportionally across the active connected signals.

## Verified Core Capabilities
- GitHub Telemetry Analysis: Queries the public GitHub REST API to audit original (non-fork) repositories, commit cadence, language byte distribution, and documentation standards without requiring private or write access.
- ATS Resume Optimizer: Parses PDF resumes via server-side text stream extraction (using pdf-parse) to evaluate ATS keyword alignment, technical section completeness, and suggest quantified achievement rewrites.
- Skill Gap Diagnostics: Cross-references detected tools from GitHub and resumes against role benchmarks to categorize missing tools into Critical, Important, and Nice-to-Have tiers.
- 12-Week Career Roadmap: Generates a milestone-driven 12-week progression (2 weekly goals per week, 3 monthly milestones, and capstone project specifications) tailored to target tracks.
- Developer Portfolio Audit: Safely fetches live portfolio URLs to evaluate HTML structure, viewport tags, OpenGraph metadata, and live proof-of-work demonstration links.

## Explicit Technical Limitations & Privacy Boundaries
- Zero Write Permissions: DevLeveler strictly performs read-only public queries; it never writes to repositories, pushes commits, or modifies user accounts.
- Public Repositories Only: Private repositories and proprietary enterprise code are not accessed without explicit user connection.
- Native PDF Stream Parsing: DevLeveler extracts text streams directly from encoded PDFs. It does not use Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to parse image scans.
- Structural HTML Inspection: Portfolio audits analyze HTML document structure and metadata; they do not emulate headless browser Lighthouse millisecond profilers.
- No Artificial Ranking Guarantees: DevLeveler provides objective telemetry to help developers showcase proof-of-work; it does not promise or guarantee job placement.
